'''Grub''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Evocii]] [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] [[Supreme Mogul]] [[Karagga]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Following the [[Annexation of neutral systems]] by Karagga the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] in [[3639 BBY]], and in view of a possible armed conflict between the Cartel and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], Grub was sent to mediate on the Hutt's behalf with the Empire's [[Rove (Ambassador)|ambassador Rove]] aboard the ''[[Ziost Shadow]]''. Grub tried to downplay Karagga's aggression, yet as the negotiations stalled, Rove authorized an Imperial strike team to shuttle down to the surface of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Hutta]] to discuss the matter with Karagga face-to-face. The negotiations having broken apart, the confrontation ended in violence as Karagga was killed, leaving the leadership position of the Hutt Cartel vacant.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Evocii]], Grub served the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] as an [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] during the [[Galactic War]] between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Around [[3639 BBY]],<ref name="Year">{{TOR updates|1.1}}</ref> Grub was aboard the Sith Empire's [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] ''[[Ziost Shadow]]'', meeting Ambassador [[Rove (Ambassador)|Rove]] of the [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]], as an Imperial strike team arrived.

==Personality and traits==
Despite his Evocii people being greatly mistreated by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]],<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Evocii}}</ref> Grub worked as their representative.

==Behind the scenes==
Ambassador Grub appears in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in Update 1.1 "Rise of the Rakghouls". He is featured in the Empire-sided operation "Karagga's Palace," as part of the quest "Best Foot Forward."<ref name="SWTOR" />
